title: TOSS 5 must not have the quagga package installed.
check_content:
Verify the "quagga" package is not installed using the following command:

$ sudo dnf list --installed quagga

Error: No matching Packages to list

If the "quagga" package is installed and is not documented with the information system security officer (ISSO) as an operational requirement, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Remove the "quagga" package using the following command:

$ sudo dnf remove quagga
VulnDiscussion:
Quagga is a network routing software suite providing implementations of Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), Routing Information Protocol (RIP), and Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) for Unix and Linux platforms.

If there is no need to make the router software available, removing it provides a safeguard against its activation.
